items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I just gigged with Elmer Snowden, you know.

ctx.x: How about your period with Elmer Snowden? You were largely with June Clark, but you also played also with Elmer. In other words, these were your gigs --
Yeah, these were the gigs with Elmer Snowden. I just gigged with Elmer Snowden, you know.

After the Club Kentucky gig was over with June Clark, we just went into another phrase of gigging around. (inaudible). This was leading up to the time when we doing all this -- you know, doing like gigging here and running here. Playing with this guy, Elmer Snowden, this guy. Whoever was the (inaudible) contractor. These guys like Elmer Snowden had -- they were like contractors for these gigs. Like, people would call them. Some of these guys, they had two or three bands they would send out. You know, they put…
